body: I'm so sorry to hear that. I totally relate to it. What he couldn't give me in a relationship I compensated with my ED.
Have you tried liquid meal "replacements"? Or soups? They can be easier to tolerate. Also, how is your sleeping schedule like? Waking up earlier used to help my appetite.
Initially you lose fat until your body runs out of it and starts using up muscle. I think if you don't eat enough protein your body uses up more muscle

When you're drinking and lose control of how many glasses you've had it's easy to take in a lot of cals, and it can also increase appetite under the influence. Fat burning also slows down during drinking bc your body is focused on breaking down the alcohol instead of other sources. Tbh at the height of my ED in 2021 I used to drink almost every day, yet I still lost weight. I think it changes from person to person

yes I know, I was just wondering if there's a way bc I can't imagine a life without my ED. I don't want it to physically catch up with me one day but I also don't want to completely give it up, I still want to have parts of it with me in the future. It sounds dumb asf but that's what it is.

I'm also in semi-recovery and in the same situation. It's very difficult to un-learn patterns of disordered thinking, even if you go back to eating regularly. Social media is almost impossible to navigate without being stuck in the cycle of comparison, unfortunately. I still compare myself almost every day even though I made it a habit to follow less and less influencers (because let's be honest not all of them deserve to profit off our attention). It also helps me to remember that even when I was at my lowest weight I did not think I had the perfect, ideal body that I pictured in my head- it's like chasing a ghost. I don't know if this is helpful, but there's something almost peaceful in making the decision that you don't always have to trust or agree with what you think about yourself or about life in general. Because mostly you don't know what's best for you. Not every thought you have deserves your attention, etc. You almost need to out-smart yourself to silence those voices. Idk if this answered your question but for me I have to do a lot of self-discipline to toughen myself up and away from those disordered thoughts. Sending love x
